faq.question: Why do some categories have fewer tools than others?
faq.answer: InterConverter is growing category by category. We focus on useful tools that are easy to use, easy to review, and worth maintaining well.

faq.question: Do the tools run in the browser?
faq.answer: Many conversion and calculation workflows run in the browser after the page loads. Site assets, analytics scripts, and advertising scripts may still load as part of the page.

faq.question: Can I rely on the result without checking it?
faq.answer: No. For high-stakes work, always verify important results independently. These tools are built to be practical and clear, but they are not a substitute for professional review.

faq.question: Do I need an account?
faq.answer: No. You can use the current online tools without creating an account.

faq.question: Can I request improvements to a page?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the contact page to report unclear copy, calculation issues, missing examples, or tools you want us to prioritize.

tips.title: Mortgage Tips
tips.tip1: A larger down payment reduces your monthly payment and eliminates PMI if 20% or more
tips.tip2: Consider the total cost of homeownership including taxes, insurance, and maintenance
tips.tip3: Shop around for the best interest rates - even 0.25% can save thousands
tips.tip4: Factor in closing costs, which typically range from 2-5% of the home price
tips.tip5: Consider a 15-year mortgage for faster payoff and less total interest
tips.tip6: Make extra principal payments to reduce the total interest paid over time
